text:
riley: heads-up — pushing a small dark-mode tweak PR for console charts + syntax. posting screenshots + notes: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/coal-ink-theme

maria: looked — overall :+1:. main concern: primary axis color reads a bit greenish on panels. can we nudge hue towards neutral blue-gray?

ash: @maria can you paste a hex you prefer? current is #2aa67a

maria: #2aa67a → try #5b7fa3 or even #6b7f95. keeps saturation low.

sam_frontend: i pushed a patch to vars, preview here: /deploy-preview/462. CSS snippet:

```
:root {
  --bg: #0b0f12;
  --panel: #0f1417;
  --text: #dbe7ee;
  --axis: #5b7fa3;
  --muted: #8a97a6;
}
```

devon: chart library maps category colors. for heatmap we should keep low saturation and boost contrast for small values. propose gradient: #071018 -> #14324a -> #5b7fa3 -> #cfe7ff

jorge_a11y: contrast nit: token-list items drop to 3.8:1 at 12px with #8a97a6 on panel bg. need >=4.5:1 for body text. Suggest bolding or increasing font-size or use #a9b7c6

design-bot: a11y-check results: token-list contrast 3.8, charts tooltips 4.1, code inline 4.6

riley: thanks @jorge_a11y — I like bolding token labels for now. we can test perf of slightly bigger font later. Also for syntax: current selection uses teal palettes for functions. feels noisy.

ash: re: syntax, propose palette: keywords #cfae67, functions #6fc2b0, strings #d6a58d, comments #6e7b85 (muted). keeps warmth but readable.

sam_frontend: can we avoid too many warm hues — logs and error states use orange/red. maybe shift functions to a cool steel (#6ea5b2) and keep keywords warm.

maria: agree with sam. +1 on steel for functions. Also chart stroke widths feel thin at 1px in dark. bump to 1.5px.

devon: done in chart config. set strokeWidth: 1.5 for lines, borderColor uses rgba(219,231,238,0.06)

riley: quick A/B ask — run a small sample with current vs adjusted palette on dash with 50 users, collect task success/heatmap clarity. @design-bot can you schedule?

design-bot: scheduled AB test: coal-ink-v1 vs coal-ink-v2 — 48h, bucket size 50 users each. I'll post results.

jorge_a11y: after tweaks, run contrast check CLI: `npx color-contrast '#0f1417' '#a9b7c6'` → 4.59

riley: sweet. I'll open a PR with the vars and chart changes. thanks all :tada:
